rows.claim: Build metadata after '+' is now ignored.
rows.evidence: The agent wrote code in ver/order.py that strips build metadata (version.split("+", 1)[0]), but no tool output tested a version containing '+'. The sort and satisfies checks used no build metadata inputs, so the behavior was never demonstrated. Also, satisfies calls key(base) and key(version) so it would be ignored there too, but this was not run either.
